name: The Mysterious APP That Summons Hot Girls
source:
A young man despised by his family discovers that he was left behind while they and his little sister go on vacation to some mysterious place. Since "you" never had a computer, you take this opportunity, if it can be called that, to use your little sister's computer. During this time, some mysterious being contacts you in the chat and makes you an offer. What could this offer be?

[From [url=https://abbys-cat.itch.io/the-mysterious-app-that-summons-hot-girls]itch.io[/url]]
